name: Core v2 股市调研分析示例

research_preferences.as_of_date_policy: use runtime date and cite retrieval times

prompt_policy.user_prompt: Normalize the stock request into target_profile, research_scope, constraints, and watchlist_seed. Do not recommend. Preserve ticker/name, market, currency assumptions, as_of_date policy, and explicit research questions. Put uncertain identity fields in data_gaps.
Parallel public-data collection workflow. Produce a complete evidence_pack plus only blocking gaps and quality gate; do not pass raw process logs downstream.
Coverage gate and model-input builder. Decide whether evidence is sufficient and build the model_input_pack used downstream.
Domain analysis workflow for business model, financial quality, segment economics, and industry position based on evidence_pack and model_input_pack.
Sequential valuation workflow: operating forecast, comparables, DCF/SOTP, scenario sensitivity, and auditable price guidance.
Risk and catalyst workflow that separates verified evidence, monitoring triggers, and unverified watchlist items.
Report workflow that compiles thesis, claim-to-evidence map, decision summary, appendix, and evidence-aware price guidance status.

Review report, claim_to_evidence_map, price_guidance, risk outputs, evidence_pack, and appendix. Do not add facts or new research. Return publication readiness, unsupported claims, required followups, and action_items only.
